businesses.business: Enterprise data capture and workflow technology

offering_description.value: Zebra sells mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID systems, and workflow software to retailers, logistics operators, manufacturers, healthcare providers, and public agencies. It designs the equipment and develops the software, uses contract manufacturers for much of its hardware, and delivers systems through channel partners and direct sales. It also offers machine vision and interactive touch systems.

primary_products.value: Rugged mobile computers and barcode scanners; barcode and label printers and supplies; RFID readers and tags; workforce and inventory software; machine vision and interactive touch systems

primary_services.value: Device maintenance and repair; deployment and integration; managed device services; technical training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Retailers, warehouse operators, parcel carriers, manufacturers, hospitals, and other healthcare providers; B2G: Government agencies that track assets or equip field workers

end_markets.value: Retail and e-commerce; transportation and logistics; manufacturing; healthcare; government and public services

revenue_model.value: product sales: Mobile devices, scanners, printers, labels, tags, imaging equipment, and touch systems; service fees: Device maintenance, repair, deployment, and fleet management; subscription: Cloud software for workforce scheduling, retail operations, and inventory visibility; licensing or royalties: Licenses for installed workflow and machine vision software
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Designs equipment from sourced components and sells it to channel partners and enterprise customers; brand owner: Markets its own hardware designs produced by contract manufacturers to resellers and enterprise buyers; software / platform: Develops applications that turn device and enterprise data into workflows for retailers, warehouses, and manufacturers; service provider: Deploys, repairs, and manages equipment fleets for enterprise customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Enterprise mobility, identification and tracking, workflow software, industrial imaging, and interactive touch systems

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Technology distributors that supply equipment and consumables to resellers; partners / resellers: Value-added resellers and systems integrators that configure and install customer systems; direct sales: Enterprise account teams serving large customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Radio-equipped devices face FCC and equivalent overseas rules, hardware also faces product safety and environmental requirements.

notes: The current scope of the industrial automation portfolio is uncertain.
